_about: Concept-to-item map for the HTN domain (addendum HTN v1, sections 3 and 5). The 12-Concept vocabulary is the frozen CKD file (concepts_constructs_v1.json, SHA-256 6db9963a...), unchanged. Written 12/11/2026 before any HTN extraction.
outcome_rule: Edges with BLOOD_PRESSURE at either end are recorded in the KG (they are guideline routes to the outcome) but are not used by the audit or by route-aware enforcement, because BLOOD_PRESSURE is not a feature of the HTN domain. With k = 2, a path through BLOOD_PRESSURE does not count, because an intermediate node must be a treatable feature of the domain.
item_pairs_secondary: lever/treatable items {BMI, Smoker, PhysActivity, HighChol} x targets {BMI, Smoker, PhysActivity, HighChol, GenHlth, MentHlth}, u != v: 20 item pairs
construct_mismatch_threats: PhysActivity 2017-2020 is occupational vigorous activity (PAQ605); the 2021-2023-only analysis is the matched sensitivity for routes from exercise (as prereg v3 4.4).

Guideline levers with no NHANES feature in this schema (sodium, potassium, DASH-type diet, alcohol, stress management, sleep) can route only to the outcome or to unmapped Concepts; they do not enter the audit.
